source.name: GISP2 Ice Core Temperature and Accumulation Data (Alley 2000)
source.download_verification: curl HTTP 200, byte size matches prior Phase 0 verification (116283 bytes); file content inspected directly (header, column definitions at lines 72-75, 1632-row temperature data block at lines 76-1707) before parsing.
source.reference: Alley, R.B. 2000. The Younger Dryas cold interval as viewed from central Greenland. Quaternary Science Reviews 19:213-226.
source.columns: Column 1: Age (thousand years before present, kyr BP); Column 2: Temperature in central Greenland (degrees C)

transition.operational_definition: pre-transition segment = all samples with Age (kyr BP) > 11.5, strictly
transition.note: The GISP2 age grid is irregular (~0.015-0.03 kyr spacing in this interval), not a regular grid; 11.5 kyr BP does not fall exactly on a sample. The threshold Age > 11.5 was applied strictly (no rounding/snapping), so the most recent (last) sample retained in the primary pre-transition segment is the closest sample with Age > 11.5, and the closest overall sample to 11.5 (age=11.496) falls just on the post-transition side and is excluded from both variants.

segments.ordering: chronological, oldest first (Age descending) as required by methodology

primary.definition: all available record with Age > 11.5 kyr BP (from record start ~49.981 kyr BP to the transition)

robustness.definition: most recent 50% (by sample count, floor division) of the primary segment
